tei:div.tei:p: (na)༄༅// bka' gdams do kor ba'i zhus lan bzhugs// ༄༅// oṃ swa sti siddhaṃ/ bla ma dang mgon po 'jam pa'i dbyangs la phyag 'tshal lo// so sor thar pa 'dul ba bzhin// byang chub sems dpa' mdo sde'i lugs// gsang sngags rgyud sde bzhin ston pa'i// 'jam dbyangs bla ma rgyal gyur cig /ring 'ongs skyes bu dam pa'i pho nya yis// yang yang gsol ba 'debs pa'i ngor byas te// ji ltar zhu ba'i don rnams rim pa bzhin// lan cig brjod pa 'di la dga' bas nyon// dang por dbang gis ma smin par// sems bskyed yang dag thob pa des// byang sems rnal ma 'byongs gyur na// rnam rgyal don yod zhags pa sogs// bya ba'i rgyud ni 'ga' zhig btub// bslab gsum ldan pa'i gang zag gis// sdom gsum spang blang nang 'gal tshe// dgag bya dang ni dgos pa gnyis// gtso bo gang che'i lugs su bya// skyabs 'gro smon 'jug byang sems kyang*// thun tshod dag la ltos pa ste// lung chos spyi yi dgongs pa yin// de yang grub mtha' so so yi// gzhung nas bshad pa dag dang bstun// rgyud sde'i dgongs pa dam tshig ni// thun tshod dag la mi ltos te// bya ba zin pa nyid kyis chog /rgyud sde pha ma'i khyad par ni// gtso cher phrin las ston pa dang*// thabs lam gtso bor ston la dgongs// phyi nang gnyis te rnying ma'i lugs// gsar ma'i rgyud tu ma grags te// bris sku gtso bor byed pa dang*// rang gi lus la gtsor byed pa// phyi nang gnyis kyi khyad par te// rnying ma'i nang na de skad lo// rgyud sde bzhi yi khyad par ni// mi rigs bzhi dang dus tshod bzhi// nyon mongs sgo nas gsungs pa ste// 'di ni rgyud dang mthun par gda'// rig 'dzin sdom pa'i ngo bo ni// rdo rje theg pa'i sgor zhugs te// gang zag gcig gis phrin las rnams// ma lus grub pa'i dam tshig dang*// ldan pa gcig la zer te mchis// sngags dang pha rol phyin pa gnyis// sku dang ye shes phrin las kyis// rdzogs 'tshang rgya bar don gcig kyang*// ma rmongs thabs mang dka' med dang*// dbang po rnon po'i dbang byas pas// sngags kyi theg pa khyad par 'phags// dbu tshad grub mtha'i rnam dbye 'di// gus pas khyed la zhu'o skad// 'di don smra ba mang na yang*// 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyis rjes bzung bas// don ldan rtogs pa kho bo tsam// rgyas par rigs gter nang na mchis// tha snyad du ni mi bslu bar// 'dod pa de ni tshad ma'i lugs// dbu ma pa la rnam gnyis te// rang rgyud de dang cha mthun la// thal 'gyur pa dag tha snyad du'ang*// bden par mi 'dod mdor bsdus pa'o// bden pa gnyis kyi dbye don ni// don dam du ni dbyer med pas// gcig dang tha dad gang yang med// tha snyad ngo bo dbyer med la// ldog pa dag ni tha dad 'dod// khyod kyi dri ba brgyad pa'i lan// don dam shes bya ma yin te// gzhan sel shes byar 'gro ba'ang srid// kun rdzob legs par rtogs tsam na// don dam logs su lus pa med// sar gnas byang chub sems dpa' la// mnyam rjes khyad par shin tu che// snang bcas snang ba med pa ste// bdag gis rtogs kyis gzhan gyis min// rdzogs sangs rgyas kyi ye shes ni// yod med mtha' las 'das pa'o// sku gzugs rten gyi rab gnas kyang*// lo bcu lon pa'i bsnyen rdzogs kyis// mkhan po'i las la 'jug pa ltar// 'di yang rdo rje slob dpon gyi// dbang bskur thob pa kho na'i las// bka' gdams 'dul ba'i sgor zhugs nas// rab gnas rim lnga bdun tshigs sogs// mdzad kyang ngal ba don med yin// 'on kyang khyed kyis dris pa'i lan// rab tu gnas pa byed dus su// chos sku rang bzhin gzhir gzhag ste// gnas lugs spros pa dang bral bas// de la rab gnas bshad pa med// dam tshig sems dpar bskyed pa la// ye shes sems dpa' spyan drangs nas// mchod cing bstod nas bstim pa la// rab gnas dngos gzhir rgyud las bshad// sangs rgyas bstan pa rin po che// mdor bsdus nyams su len pa'i tshe// 'dul ba phar phyin gsang sngags gsum// so so'i gzhung dang mi 'gal bar// nyams su len pa bka' dang mthun// 'on kyang stong nyid snying rje yi// snying po can du bsgom par zhu// da lta'i chos pa phal che rnams// 'dul ba'i sde snod mi shes par// nyan thos bstan pa'i nang du min// sems bskyed cho ga 'khrugs gyur pas// pha rol phyin pa'i gzhung dang bral// dbang dang rim gnyis mi bsgom pas// rdo rje theg la rgyab kyis phyogs// de bas lto phyi'i chos par go

/dbang po rab kyi gang zag kyang*// sa lam bgrod dgos myur du 'grub// 'bring dang tha ma rim pas 'grub// sa lam nges med sangs rgyas te// phyag rgya chen po chig chod la// sa lam brtsi ba'i rmongs pa 'khrul// de skad zer ba bstan pa yi// bdud tshig yin pas rna ba dgab// de nyid bcu la rnam grangs mang*// cho ga'i de nyid bcu dang ni// gzhan yang rdo rje slob dpon la// nye bar mkho ba'i de nyid bcu// de bzhin de nyid kho na yi// de nyid bcu zhes bya ba yod// nges par de nyid bcur bshad pa// dgos pa chung bas 'dir ma bris// lha sku'i ngo bo gcig shes pas// mchog sgrub ye shes lha rnams ni// thams cad thugs dgongs gcig pas na// gcig 'grub thams cad 'grub pa yin// nor sgrub la sogs thun mong gi /dngos grub lha rnams de lta min// byang chub mchog gi phyag rgya can// rnam snang la sogs rigs lnga la// thams cad sku mdog ser 'byam du// bri ba bka' gdams bstan bcos las// bshad pa yod na shin tu legs// rgyud las bshad pa ngas ma mthong*// sku mdog ye shes rnam lnga dang*// 'byung ba rnam pa lnga la dgongs// phyag rgya nang gi rten 'brel yin// 'di yi rgyu mtshan zhib pa ru// bshad kyang khyod kyi spyod yul min// gang zag gson por gyur pa la// bum pa 'cha' ba'i cho ga de// rgyud las dbang bskur rang du bshad// dbang bskur byed na rgyu dus su// khyod kyis dbang bskur thob bam ci// zhe dgu'i bar du gshin po la// bdun tshigs cho ga bshad pa de// rnam shes bkug nas mdzad par gda'// rnam par shes pa ma bkug par// gson po'i sgrib pa sbyang ba'i phyir// 'gal ba med dam sems pa la// khrus kyi cho ga ma gtogs pa// rgyud las gsungs pa med de mchi// mdor na bstan pa'i go rim ni// rab byung 'dul ba bzhin du bya// byang chub sems dpa' mdo dang bstun// gsang sngags rgyud dang mthun par bsgom// chos la yid ches ma sla bar// nyams len sangs rgyas bka' bzhin sgrubs// dal na 'di bas rgyas pa cig

/byed pa yin te long ma byung*// nged kyang bya ba ches pa dang*// khyod kyang gnas kyis bskal ba'i phyir// da res mjal ba ma 'grig pas// dris lan mdo ru bsdus pa lags// sdom brtson khyod rang byon gyur na// 'di rnams rgyas par phye ba cig /cis kyang byed dgos yin mod kyi// 'on kyang sdom gsum rab dbye la// tshar gcig gzigs pas gsal bar mchi// bdag kyang sngon gyi byed pa 'ga' yi rgyus// bstan pa'i nyi ma shar gyi phyogs su 'char// thos bsam bsgom gsum yid bzhin nor bu des// dad ldan dbus gtsang re ba rab rdzogs shog /dpal ldan sa skya paṇḍi tas lan du gsungs pa'o/// / ༈ gu rus dpar rtsa spel ba'o//
